checklist.why: Purpose line exists; no "use X instead" naming a sibling (TaskSection, rowGroup title, Log group label).
No when / when-not per kind; the owner's gap: nothing says which heading to use where.
Title, icon, description, meta, action named and all shown in the preview.
panel kind is used on one screen (farrowing.overview) and is 1px from section; its when-to-use is only "a title inside a panel".
Static text; default and empty (absent) stated; the action follows Button.
Text action hit area is 44x44 (preview "Edit"), 69x44 on piglet-processing.sheet-todo "View log"; floor is 48.
No state carried by colour; status colour banned in headings.
Sentence case and noun stated; no long-title example, no rule for how the 46%-wide aside wraps against a long title.
`level` sets the h-element; the action takes the global focus ring.
bundle.css hard-codes 22/13/12/11/10px, 12px gaps, 44px and font fallbacks; the type tokens (page-title, section-title, group-label) are not referenced.
No classification line and no related links.
All four kinds render at 375 with no overflow.

variants.name: page
findings: Fine in use; held back only by the component-wide token and doc gaps (lines 11, 14).

variants.name: section
findings: Carries the only action slot in use ("View log >" 69x44).

variants.name: panel
findings: 12px vs section 13px is not a perceptible level; one screen.

variants.name: group
findings: Always reached through rowGroup or Log, never called directly; the README should say so.

findings.text: No guidance on which kind to use when. Section, panel and group headings appear on one sheet with no rule.
findings.fix: Add a "Which heading" table. page = the screen or sheet title, once, in its header. section = names a block and sits outside, above its panel; it alone takes the icon, the meta (a count or time for the whole block) and the one link-out action. group = labels a run of rows or log entries inside one panel; muted, no icon, no action; reach it through rowGroup({title}) or Log. Never stack two headings over one block.

findings.text: panel (12px) is not a perceptible step from section (13px) and is used on one screen (farrowing.overview "Whole-task progress").
findings.fix: Merge panel into section: a title inside a panel uses section; alias kind "panel" to section and fix farrowing.overview.

findings.text: The text action is 44px tall (preview "Edit" 44x44; "View log" 69x44 on piglet-processing.sheet-todo), under the 48px glove floor.
findings.fix: Set the action min-height and min-width to control-height (48px); keep the negative margin so the heading does not grow.

findings.text: Raw values in bundle.css (22/13/12/11/10px, 12px gaps, 44px) instead of the type and space tokens the DS README names.
findings.fix: Map each kind to its type token (page-title, section-title, group-label), the gap to space-heading, the action to control-height.

findings.text: Two implementations: home, farrowing and inspection load ux/system/sentri-components.js (no data-ds, no strs); the task skeleton loads components/bundle.js.
findings.fix: Point the three prototypes at bundle.js and delete the heading/row/facts/log/segment copies in sentri-components.js.

findings.text: No long-title example; a long title beside a meta is unspecified.
findings.fix: Add a preview case with a 40-character title and a meta; state that the title wraps and the aside stays top-aligned.

proposals.name: Heading kind "panel" into "section"
proposals.why: One screen uses it and the 1px size step carries no hierarchy; the standard asks for the smallest variant set that covers real screens.
